architecture_selection: highest mean final source-validation accuracy over three preselected groups; target labels/results not consulted
source_endpoint: fixed final update count, no per-group test or validation checkpoint selection
target_tuning_policy: equal validation search for every source condition and random initialization, separately for task-free linear, query linear, task-free MLP and fine-tuning, using seed17 and averaging all targets/support budgets; condition-specific selected policies apply to all three seeds; also report the shared random-selected fine-tuning policy
final_eval_policy: new target-test data untouched until source protocol and adaptation settings are fixed; report all groups and seeds; exploratory follow-up to prior pilot
limitations: Task marginals and full joint distributions remain approximately matched.
A time-limited session may leave some planned models incomplete; incomplete runs must be distinguished from completed runs.
Source-data world is shared across initialization seeds; only a new independently generated dataset world tests data robustness.
BF16 SDPA computations need not match previous FP32 runs bitwise; all compared long-run conditions use the same numerical protocol.
